steps.name: Check formatting
steps.run:
nix develop --command cargo fmt --all -- --check
nix develop --command tools/check-provenance

steps.name: Test client and examples
steps.run:
if [ "$MODE" = blocking ]; then
  nix develop --command cargo test --locked --all-targets --features blocking
else
  nix develop --command cargo test --locked --all-targets
fi

steps.name: Check documentation and package
steps.run:
nix develop --command cargo doc --locked --all-features --no-deps
nix develop --command cargo package --locked

steps.name: Check Rust 1.95 with the committed dependency lock
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
rustup_bin=$(command -v rustup)
nix develop --command "$rustup_bin" run 1.95.0 cargo test --locked --all-targets
nix develop --command "$rustup_bin" run 1.95.0 cargo test --locked --all-targets --features blocking

steps.name: Read recorded generator revision
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
import json
revision = json.load(open('schema/provenance.json'))['generator']['revision']
assert len(revision) == 40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in revision)
print(f'revision={revision}')
PY

steps.name: Install generator dependencies and check saved source
steps.run:
export HAVEAPI_SOURCE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.haveapi-generator"
nix develop --command bundle install --gemfile "$HAVEAPI_SOURCE/clients/rust/Gemfile"
nix develop --command tools/regenerate --check

authentication.description: Registry authentication (bootstrap is first publication only)

steps.name: Validate repository, tag and package
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import subprocess
import tomllib

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(message)

require(os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'] == 'vpsfreecz/vpsadmin-rust-client',
        'Publication is restricted to vpsfreecz/vpsadmin-rust-client')
require(os.environ['AUTHENTICATION'] in ('oidc', 'bootstrap'),
        'Select oidc or bootstrap explicitly')
with open('Cargo.toml', 'rb') as manifest:
    package = tomllib.load(manifest)['package']
require(package['name'] == 'vpsadmin-client', 'Unexpected Cargo package name')
require(os.environ['GITHUB_REF_TYPE'] == 'tag'
        and os.environ['GITHUB_REF'] == 'refs/tags/v' + package['version'],
        'Dispatch against the tag v<Cargo.toml package.version>')
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
require(revision == os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'], 'Checkout differs from dispatch source')
subprocess.run(['git', 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', 'origin',
                os.environ['GITHUB_REF']], check=True)
tag_revision = subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'rev-parse', 'FETCH_HEAD^{commit}'], text=True).strip()
require(tag_revision == revision, 'Release tag moved after dispatch')
with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as output:
    output.write(f'revision={revision}\n')
PY

steps.name: Check first-publication prerequisites
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

if os.environ['BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_CONFIGURED'] != 'true':
    raise SystemExit('Missing release environment secret CARGO_PUBLISH_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN')
request = urllib.request.Request(
    'https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/vpsadmin-client',
    headers={'User-Agent': 'vpsadmin-rust-client-release'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30):
        raise SystemExit('Bootstrap requires an absent crate; select oidc for existing crates')
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    if error.code != 404:
        raise SystemExit('Registry lookup failed; bootstrap requires HTTP 404') from None
except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError):
    raise SystemExit('Registry lookup failed; refusing bootstrap') from None
PY

steps.name: Recheck verified source and release tag
steps.run:
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$RELEASE_REVISION"
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$GITHUB_REF"
test "$(git rev-parse 'FETCH_HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_REVISION"
